_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Macro gravity from absent Fed liquidity and elevated VIX/gold flight drains conviction from the coil, sliding Anxiety down one rung to Complacency as the tape bleeds out rather than crashes.
next_move.brains_agree: No — the narrative writer implies a bullish coiling resolution while the analyst explicitly calls a DOWN drift into Complacency; the analyst's higher trust weight and stronger factor evidence breaks the tie.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC breaks below $74K with funding flipping negative and stablecoin growth dropping below 40
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC closes above $80K with ETF flows surging past 40 and VIX collapsing below 50
